items.source: The container to use is identified by the container attribute defining the name of the RedisMessageListenerContainer bean to use. When none is set a RedisMessageListenerContainer bean named redisMessageListenerContainer is assumed to be present.
items.translation: 使用的容器由 `container` 属性指定，该属性定义了要使用的RedisMessageListenerContainer Bean 的名称。如果未设置该属性，则假定存在一个名为redisMessageListenerContainer的RedisMessageListenerContainer Bean。

items.source: These features are abstracted by the MessageHandlerMethodFactory that is responsible for building the necessary invoker to process the annotated method. By default, DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory is used.
items.translation: 这些特性由 `MessageHandlerMethodFactory` 抽象，该工厂负责构建必要的调用器以处理已注解的方法。默认情况下，使用 `DefaultMessageHandlerMethodFactory`。

items.source: Implementing RedisListenerConfigurer allows for fine-grained control over endpoint registration via the RedisListenerEndpointRegistrar. For example, the following configures an extra endpoint:
items.translation: 实现 RedisListenerConfigurer 允许通过 RedisListenerEndpointRegistrar 对端点注册进行细粒度控制。例如，以下配置可添加一个额外的端点：

items.source: The RedisListenerAnnotationBeanPostProcessor is responsible for creating endpoints.
The following configuration would ensure that every time a Pub/Sub is received on the topic channel named "myChannel", MyService.process() is invoked with the content of the message:
items.translation: 以下配置将确保每当在名为 "myChannel" 的主题通道上收到 Pub/Sub 消息时，都会调用 MyService.process() 方法，并传入消息内容：

items.source: Note that all beans implementing RedisListenerConfigurer will be detected and invoked in a similar fashion. The example above can be translated into a regular bean definition registered in the context in case you use the XML configuration.
items.translation: 请注意，所有实现 `RedisListenerConfigurer` 的 Bean 都将以类似的方式被检测和调用。如果您使用 XML 配置，上述示例可以转换为在上下文中注册的普通 Bean 定义。

items.source:
package com.acme.foo;

public class MyService {

        @RedisListener(container = "myRedisListenerContainer", topic = "myChannel")
        public void process(String msg) {
                // process incoming message
        }
}
items.translation:
package com.acme.foo;

public class MyService {

    @RedisListener(container = "myRedisListenerContainer", topic = "myChannel")
    public void process(String msg) {
        // 处理传入的消息
    }
}

@Configuration
@EnableRedisListeners
public class AppConfig implements RedisListenerConfigurer {

        @Override

        }

}
